verdict.rationale: Aleph documents Scan, an AI analyst that runs flux and variance analysis and gives 'clear commentary on what changed and why it matters.' Users can set a materiality threshold, Scan suggests explanatory dimensions such as vendor name, and it reports when nothing notable is found rather than inventing explanations. Board-ready variance analysis and cited, traceable answers round this out. missing for 10: explicit documentation of budget-to-actual (vs. period-over-period flux) explanations, in-depth docs on how drivers are attributed, independent or hands-on corroboration.
